title: Common providers: South Korea
coverage: Complete for the three national carriers, the mobile network operators and the main cable operators; business ISPs are partial, and five websites did not answer an automated check.
missing: Regional cable operators and the regional AS numbers of CMB (only its head-office number is listed)
Smaller business ISPs and data-centre networks
Websites of LG U+, HCN, Sejong Telecom, Dreamline and KOREN (none answered an automated check on the read date)

sources.name: Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT)
sources.terms: The site answered but its pages are drawn by script and its terms could not be read by an automated request: nothing is copied.
sources.result: No public register of facilities-based operators was found in the time given. The ministry is the authority to consult for operators this pack lacks; AS numbers of South Korea are assigned through KISA (KRNIC).

sources.name: Wikipedia: Internet in South Korea
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 7 of 13 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Wikipedia: Telecommunications in South Korea
sources.terms: CC BY-SA 4.0. Used to cross-check names only (facts); no text is copied.
sources.result: 4 of 13 entries were found on the page under their name or one of their other names.

sources.name: Each provider's own public website
sources.terms: Only the address itself is recorded (a fact); no content is copied.
sources.result: 8 of 13 websites answered an automated check; an address that did not answer, or that refused an automated request, is left empty. No support or status page was checked.

sources.name: RIPEstat as-overview (RIPE NCC)
sources.terms: The RIPEstat terms forbid redistributing RIPEstat data: nothing is copied. Consulted to confirm, for each AS number, that the registered holder is the named provider.
sources.result: 19 AS numbers confirmed; a number whose registered holder was another company or an unrelated name was left out.

sources.name: APNIC RDAP (the registry's own record of an AS number)
sources.terms: The APNIC Whois terms allow lookups for internet operational purposes and forbid bulk copying or redistribution without consent: nothing is copied.
sources.result: Read where the holder name in RIPEstat did not name the provider plainly.

sources.name: NRO delegated statistics (the regional registries' joint list of assigned AS numbers)
sources.terms: Published by the registries for public use; only which registry holds each AS number is taken (a fact).
sources.result: Every AS number in the pack was found in the list; its registry is recorded beside it.

sources.name: PeeringDB
sources.terms: The acceptable use policy forbids reproducing PeeringDB data outside approved operational purposes: nothing is copied; cited as a place to look up an AS number.

providers.name: KT
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. AS4766 is KORNET.

providers.name: SK브로드밴드
providers.notes: Fixed arm of the SK group. AS9277 came with the cable operator Tbroad, merged in 2020.

providers.name: LG유플러스
providers.notes: Fixed and mobile. The AS numbers are still registered under the former names LG Dacom and LG Powercomm.

providers.name: SK텔레콤
providers.notes: Mobile; fixed services are sold through SK Broadband.

providers.name: CMB
providers.notes: Cable. Its regional systems hold AS numbers of their own, which are not listed.

providers.name: KINX
providers.notes: Carrier-neutral exchange, data centres and transit.

providers.name: KREONET
providers.notes: The national research network, run by KISTI.

providers.name: KOREN
providers.notes: Research test-bed network of the National Information Society Agency.
